prompt: A locked, murky, grainy night view from a lens high in the attic rafters, looking down at Brandon on his narrow bed, turned away from us on his side with the duvet pulled up to his ears and one arm in a white cast resting on top of the cover, the whole shape small and still. A thin line of orange from a streetlamp enters through the skylight and lies across the floorboards, and a laptop lid on the floor is closed. A mug and a pill packet sit on a crate beside the bed. The colours are washed out, there is no writing on the picture, and nothing explicit is shown. Thanks.
